title: How to Add a Sidebar to a Static Page
text:
## How to Add a Sidebar to a Static Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000002791
To add a sidebar to a static page, navigate to My Content » Web Page Builder and click " Edit " for an existing page, or click the New Web Page button to create a new one.
How to Create a New Static Page
The sidebar options are under the Display Options tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180357262/original/sC8myGrVHsl9XyjF7LSF0ZaYGX8IHtg7lQ.png?1781309312 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180357302/original/I4j7yPnG7ANQUNtQ02VZ_1dqn-mGkHgJ4w.png?1781309368 | alt: ]
Two settings on this tab control the sidebar:
1. Show Sidebar - Select which sidebar this page will use:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180357330/original/e8SIP58uAP8-iRIJsf9zeQB1tgtSRXkHSg.png?1781309438 | alt: ]
2. Sidebar Position - Determines which side of the page the sidebar appears on:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180357334/original/pzWEVgyGa7F53Ff5m3rUhzL2Lh4YFOCPLA.png?1781309496 | alt: ]
The Display Options tab also contains settings unrelated to sidebars, such as the breadcrumb trail and options to hide the header, footer, or banner ads.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180357362/original/bTHljMCth8DEFRWwdHj--6elGjkciIXT_A.png?1781309600 | alt: ]
This is how the page looks after saving the new sidebar display settings:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180357372/original/MxyO2I8MeBM1V7kscbQbUdW5cDb60CofBg.png?1781309707 | alt: ]
